svg.title: CPU and GPU chips compared with the same number of units: a CPU core spends its area on control logic and caches for two threads, a streaming multiprocessor on arithmetic lanes and a large register file for 2048 threads; the CPU has a large L3 cache, the GPU a smaller L2 cache but much faster memory
svg.text: control logic and caches make each thread as fast as possible
lanes and registers keep as many threads as possible busy
